description: Search evipedia.ai evidence reviews by name, synonym, keyword, or category. A discovery tool: returns the matching reviews (goal-qualified topic + URL) ranked by relevance so you can tell whether a review exists. To read one, pass its slug to get_conclusion (quick bottom line) or get_review (full Markdown).

query.description: Search query — intervention name, synonym, drug class, or category

name: search_reviews
